model_prediction: Additional valid cardinal and feasibility information narrows allocation ambiguity
empirical_construct: score-order and acreage-share uncertainty by information layer
required_data: timestamped score components; margin inputs; acreage; observable constraints
required_temporal_resolution: pre-decision score vintage plus subsequent acreage year
sign_or_pattern: identified acreage range should not widen under genuinely nested information
aggregation_risk: state/county averaging can create or erase order
observable_or_latent: scores and acreage observable; optimizer set latent
additional_data_needed: geography-matched margins and authoritative constraint ranges
admissible_claim: Observed variables narrow a descriptive allocation-consistency set
inadmissible_claim: The remaining set is the farmer's true optimizer set
notes: Observed acreage is never inserted as an optimality constraint

model_prediction: A feasible profitable risk-feasible exchange rules out reversal in the model
required_data: pre-decision margins; crop bounds; budgets/rotation proxies; downside scenarios
required_temporal_resolution: multi-year pre-decision inputs and next acreage
sign_or_pattern: reversal should be less compatible where every modeled exchange is feasible
observable_or_latent: margins partly observed; private feasibility and risk latent
additional_data_needed: farm constraints or defensible partial-identification bounds
admissible_claim: A registered model admits or blocks an exchange under stated inputs
inadmissible_claim: Farmers face the modeled exchange or optimize CVaR
notes: Risk-feasible exchange is primarily simulation evidence

model_prediction: With only a simplex and unique positive top margin the top crop receives all modeled land
required_data: top expected margin; land; absence of other constraints
sign_or_pattern: winner-take-all only in verified unrestricted anchor
aggregation_risk: aggregates almost surely mix constrained farms
observable_or_latent: margins and acreage partly observable; absence of constraints not observed
admissible_claim: The restricted model predicts top-rank concentration
inadmissible_claim: Observed nonconcentration falsifies the full teacher model
notes: Use only as a boundary case

model_prediction: Cardinal margin gaps can matter even when rank is fixed
empirical_construct: acreage-share transition versus continuous margin-gap change
required_data: geography-matched price; yield; cost vintages; scores; acreage
required_temporal_resolution: at least one pre-decision margin and subsequent acreage transition
sign_or_pattern: no universal sign; pre-register spline/heterogeneity and retain nulls
additional_data_needed: local costs and prices with uncertainty
admissible_claim: Acreage transitions are associated with pre-decision cardinal gaps conditional on score rank
inadmissible_claim: Margin gaps causally determine optimal acreage
notes: Separate fixed-rank strata from score changes

model_prediction: Certified local pressures reconstruct model stationarity
required_data: all registered model inputs and solver primal-dual outputs
sign_or_pattern: residual within tolerance; no empirical sign prediction
additional_data_needed: complete calibrated constraints and accepted simulation
admissible_claim: The implemented model satisfies the registered KKT identity
inadmissible_claim: Duals are observed farmer preferences or causal acreage effects
notes: No direct empirical analogue for risk dual

model_prediction: Operational restrictions can force, pressure or select reversal through distinct channels
empirical_construct: constraint status and acreage transition heterogeneity
required_data: authoritative rotation/policy rules; contract/budget proxies; crop bounds; acreage
sign_or_pattern: channel-specific; direct-forcing claims require range separation
observable_or_latent: some public rules observed; private contracts/budgets latent
additional_data_needed: farm contracts; lender terms; equipment/capacity data
admissible_claim: Observed patterns are consistent with a named operational channel under stated proxies
inadmissible_claim: A binding proxy caused reversal or reveals a shadow price
notes: Policy changes may support stronger designs later

model_prediction: Tighter modeled CVaR limits contract feasible sets and weakly lower modeled value
required_data: profit-tail measures; acreage transitions; credit/risk proxies
aggregation_risk: tail estimates unstable in short/aggregated panels
observable_or_latent: profit tails observable with data; farmer kappa latent
additional_data_needed: farm-level risk constraints or credible lender covenant data
admissible_claim: Acreage patterns vary with registered downside-exposure measures
inadmissible_claim: Observed acreage identifies a CVaR limit or its shadow price
notes: Current data cannot validate the constraint mechanism

model_prediction: Selected block effects depend on model order and selection
required_data: complete model inputs and counterfactual outputs
aggregation_risk: ecological data cannot identify block contributions
admissible_claim: No empirical acreage contribution is claimed from simulation blocks
inadmissible_claim: Observed acreage change equals a Shapley mechanism contribution
notes: Empirical work may compare only named predictions

model_prediction: A verified adverse loss order contracts modeled opportunity sets
required_data: crop-level local yields prices costs; dependence uncertainty
sign_or_pattern: aggregate CVaR exposure may rise under the verified model order
timing: outcomes used for estimation precede tested allocation when predictive
observable_or_latent: joint profits partly observable; order/model latent
admissible_claim: A named fitted model exhibits the stated ordered-risk pattern with uncertainty
inadmissible_claim: A larger scalar tail coefficient caused acreage reversal

model_prediction: Within-family dependence may alter selected acreage and reversal regions
empirical_construct: acreage transition heterogeneity by pre-decision dependence estimates
required_data: long synchronized profit histories; model inputs; acreage
sign_or_pattern: no universal direction; family-specific preregistered pattern
timing: dependence estimate uses only information available before allocation
aggregation_risk: short panels and geography mixing can reverse tails
observable_or_latent: dependence estimated with error; farmer model latent
additional_data_needed: longer panel and forecast-vintage dependence model
admissible_claim: Observed transitions are consistent or inconsistent with a named family-specific prediction
inadmissible_claim: Tail dependence is the identified causal mechanism

model_prediction: Concentration variance and tail outcomes can disagree
empirical_construct: acreage HHI versus synchronized profit variance/CVaR
required_data: acreage shares; local crop profit panel
timing: risk window precedes or is separated from outcome test
aggregation_risk: state HHI mixes farms and cannot measure farm portfolios
observable_or_latent: acreage concentration observed; farm portfolio risk partly latent
additional_data_needed: farm-level crop mix and local profit outcomes
admissible_claim: Lower acreage concentration need not coincide with lower estimated tail exposure
inadmissible_claim: More crops imply lower farmer risk or welfare gain

model_prediction: An assumed-law policy can be true-law infeasible or feasible with nonnegative regret
required_data: frozen model; held-out true-law outcomes; policies; constraints
sign_or_pattern: violation first; regret only when feasible
aggregation_risk: model evaluation does not reveal actual farmer objective
observable_or_latent: policy and held-out outcomes model-observable; true law approximated
additional_data_needed: validated simulation and long holdout panel
admissible_claim: A frozen policy has stated out-of-sample violation/regret under the evaluation law
inadmissible_claim: Estimated regret is actual farmer welfare loss
notes: Requires GOAL-12 before any empirical use

model_prediction: Information value is zero without actionable policy change and weakly rises under a verified garbling order
required_data: timestamped forecasts; revisions; crop actions; operational sets
required_geographic_resolution: farm preferred; county if decision matched
sign_or_pattern: nonnegative modeled VOI; zero when policy invariant
aggregation_risk: published revised forecasts can leak future information
observable_or_latent: forecast vintage observable; counterfactual policies latent
additional_data_needed: archived forecast vintages and action-set data
admissible_claim: A frozen model's signal changes or does not change feasible policies
inadmissible_claim: Forecast accuracy alone creates realized value

model_prediction: Information and flexibility are complementary only under structural or finite-design cross-difference gates
required_data: timestamped forecast; exogenous or authoritative flexibility measure; acreage transitions
sign_or_pattern: positive only if preregistered interaction passes; zero/substitution retained
aggregation_risk: aggregate flexibility proxies invite ecological bias
observable_or_latent: signals partly observed; feasible policy lattice latent
additional_data_needed: exogenous flexibility change and archived forecasts
admissible_claim: A descriptive interaction is consistent with the model under explicit limitations
inadmissible_claim: Information and flexibility are causally complementary in practice

model_prediction: Nested flexibility alone permits zero or substitution
sign_or_pattern: zero and negative interactions are admissible
observable_or_latent: interaction observable only with strong data
admissible_claim: Observed null/substitution does not contradict the general theory
inadmissible_claim: Every flexibility expansion must raise information value
